name: github-repo-auditor
install: set -eu; python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --user 'uv==0.12.12'; export PATH="$(python3 -m site --user-base)/bin:$PATH"; uv python install 3.11.15; uv sync --locked --python 3.11.15 --extra dev --extra serve --extra config; uv run --locked --extra dev --extra serve --extra config pytest -q -k 'not semantic_index'
